items.headline: Short seller's report on Deep Fission calls the project a money pit
items.what_happened: On or about September 24, 2026, Iceberg Research published a short-seller report on Deep Fission. Iceberg calculated energy costs between $148 and $289 per MWh and said the company's NRC approval timeline is too ambitious. Deep Fission called the report highly misleading. Its stock had dropped more than 50% since the report by October 21.
items.why_it_matters: A buyer comparing Deep Fission's offer with other microreactor pricing should note this outside cost estimate, which the company disputes. It is an analyst's calculation, not a verified project cost.
items.binding_note: A third-party short-seller report and the company's rebuttal. No regulator, contract, or financing action is involved.
